title: stage sequence accepts JSON boolean and fails open
risk: Python treats bool as a subclass of int, so the stage declaration gate accepts sequence=true as a valid sequence. The task contract requires stage declaration ambiguity to fail closed; a malformed public manifest can pass validation without a blocking finding.
repair_1: In _validate_selected, require type(item.get("sequence")) is int, and preferably reject negative sequence values if the manifest contract intends an ordered positive integer. Add a regression case for sequence=true and sequence=false.
